# Mayor Cream Cheese

Cream Cheese is Fillydelphia's mayor, a minor speaking Earth pony in the G4 Friendship is Magic television continuity. Remember him as the blue stallion who argues with another mayor in Canterlot, then cheerfully invites him to play golf.

- Appearance: pale blue coat, dark blue mane and tail, green eyes, and a Philadelphia cheesesteak cutie mark. [Character catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Stallions)
- Name and voice: Mayor Cream Cheese is spoken in the episode, not merely a fandom name; the end credits identify him by office, Mayor of Fillydelphia, and credit Tony Alcantar. His name alludes to Philadelphia cream cheese. [Season seven credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_seven)
- Appearance: A Royal Problem (S7E10, 2017); no further appearance or alternate identity verified. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QZ7WQMBjOCg)
- Visual reference: [Equestria Daily episode follow-up](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2017/06/a-royal-problem-episode-followup-20.html) includes the mayors' scene from the Hasbro/DHX production. A standalone character image asset could not be verified, so no embedded image is supplied.

## Important moments

Both scenes are in A Royal Problem (S7E10); timestamps unavailable. [Episode dialogue transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/A_Royal_Problem)

- The town hall dispute: Cream Cheese expects the princess to take his side against Baltimare's mayor, presenting Luna with a difficult diplomatic task while she is covering Celestia's duties.
- Golf after a three-hour argument: Once the dispute is settled, he jokes about its length and confirms their golf plans, showing that the two mayors remain on friendly terms despite their disagreement.
